description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure Azure Blob Storage as grain storage in Orleans hosting. It provides methods to add Azure Blob storage as default or named grain storage with various configuration options.

classes.name: AzureBlobGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure Azure Blob Storage as grain storage in Orleans.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Blob Storage as the default grain storage with provided options.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Blob Storage for grain storage, with options for named storage and configuration.
